name: Gunpowder Cocktail
source:
A young man, abandoned by his father and whose family is not well off, finds a bag filled with $500.000 while walking on the street. Will things really work out as he imagined for the young man who didn't hesitate for a moment to take the bag?

[From Patreon]
translation:
一个遭父亲抛弃、家境拮据的年轻男子在街上行走时，发现了一袋装着50万美元的现金。面对这袋钱，他毫不犹豫地拿走了。这个年轻人真的能如愿以偿吗？

[来源：Patreon]
